title: Soap bubble material with thin-film colours
purpose: Build a soap bubble material: a reflective layer whose thin-film thickness grows from top to bottom like a draining film and swirls with noise, mixed over a transparent shader by Fresnel so the bubble is clear face on and iridescent at grazing angles. Use it for bubbles and iridescent films.

parameters.name: top_thickness
parameters.description: Film thickness at the top of the object.

parameters.name: bottom_thickness
parameters.description: Film thickness at the bottom of the object.

parameters.name: swirl
parameters.description: How far the swirling noise moves the thickness.

parameters.name: film_ior
parameters.description: Index of refraction of the soap film.

parameters.name: assign
parameters.description: Assign the material to the active object.

outputs.description: One material with a node tree; assigned to the active object.

limits: Needs the Thin Film inputs of the Principled BSDF (Blender 4.2 or newer). The film is shaded on a single surface with no refraction through a liquid layer, which suits thin bubbles but not thick soap water. Drainage follows the object's generated Z, so rotating the object rotates it. Rendered here with Cycles CPU only. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Thin-film interference through the Principled BSDF thin film inputs
Gravity drainage as a thickness gradient over height
Fresnel mix of a transparent and a reflective shader
